original_description: Astria creative skills with agent-assisted local MCP setup. Connect an Astria account through your host to generate images and videos.

observed_skill_excerpt.name: astria-api
observed_skill_excerpt.text: Generate or edit images and videos with Astria. Use for product photography, virtual try-on, fashion lookbooks, professional headshots from photos, consistent people or products across scenes, and running saved photoshoot templates.

summary_ja: Astriaに接続して画像や動画を生成・編集し、商品写真や人物写真などの制作を支援する。
limitations: ホスト経由のAstriaアカウント接続とローカルMCP設定が必要との説明。実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
